scope: Entirely synthetic; hypothetical cross-functional operations, not Fortra data

IT dashboard.definition: All resolved tickets / all tickets opened

Security dashboard.definition: Critical tickets resolved within the sample target / all created critical tickets

findings.title: Review critical-cohort completion against the sample target
findings.observation: 41.2% of all created critical items were resolved within the illustrative target. Open items count as incomplete, not proven overdue.
findings.decision: Investigate critical-item routing and target-clock assumptions before assessing operational health.
findings.validation: Confirm target clock rules, pause states and severity taxonomy with both teams.

findings.title: Keep unlike KPI definitions explicit
findings.observation: Overall closure is 82.8%; critical intake completed within the sample target is 41.2%. These answer different questions, with different populations and completion criteria.
findings.decision: Approve separate names and definitions rather than averaging the two scores.
findings.validation: Check business purpose and sign off metric glossary with functional owners.

findings.title: Define a consistent operational review cadence
findings.observation: Reporting ownership and exceptions should be visible alongside each metric.
findings.decision: Use a monthly leadership review with named owners and exception commentary.
findings.evidence: Proposed operating model, not an observed company process
findings.validation: Pilot definitions on approved data; measure reviewer workload before scaling.
